instructions.D_16_system_settings: FINAL D16 SETTINGS-MASTER BLUEPRINT RETRY. In the four-cell reference board, the top-right ITERATION_TARGET is the approved D16 semantic and structural blueprint. Copy its full-screen geometry, rail widths, header baseline, content boundaries, field rhythm, and anchored footer exactly; do not crop, reinterpret, or replace either rail. The viewport must begin with one slim dark Product rail flush to the left edge, containing the established Product destinations and showing 设置 as the single cinnabar-selected item. Immediately to its right place one separate light grouped Settings rail headed 设置分组 with helper 可查看并管理全部分组. Preserve the exact grouped rail inventory and order: 总览; 基础设置 with 常规 selected, 存储, 运行保护, 安全与用户; 设备与通信 with PLC, TCP, 相机, 工作站通信; 系统服务 with AI 模型, 数据库维护. To the right of the Product rail, keep one ClearVision STUDIO global header. Its utility cluster contains only 本地服务在线, 外观：浅色·紧凑, 更多, and the exact account identity fixture-settings / 管理员; do not substitute f06-engineer, 工程师, another account, a folder shortcut, horizontal global navigation, clock, help, notification, language, or window controls. In the continuous main work surface preserve the exact page heading 设置; description 管理基础配置，设备连接和系统维护。每个分组独立保存，未保存内容会在离开前提醒。; status 设置已加载; 当前账户：管理员; and refresh command 刷新基础设置. Preserve one flat 常规设置 sheet with description 设置软件标题和默认主题。顶栏中的个人外观偏好不会被此处覆盖。 and only these three real fields: 软件标题 = ClearVision Browser with helper 显示在软件窗口和产品标识附近。; 产品主题 = 浅色 with helper 作为未设置个人外观偏好时的默认主题。; 自动启动（兼容字段） = 未启用 as a disabled read-only field with helper 当前版本不使用此项，保持只读。. Preserve the single anchored footer with 当前分组已保存, 放弃修改, and one 保存常规设置 command. Cinnabar is reserved for Product/Settings navigation selection; 保存常规设置 must use the shared action blue, never cinnabar or red. Use green only for loaded/saved state and red only for error. Add no password field, duplicate settings tabs, extra category, telemetry, desktop controls, enabled auto-start, second save path, invented setting, card wall, oversized blank field, or alternate shell. Produce one single full-screen ClearVision Studio UI at requested gpt-image-2 high 3840x2160; never output the reference board or a collage.
